lv-case.title: Latvian literary dictionary: klausīties
lv-case.evidence: The dictionary gives both transitive accusative and intransitive locative constructions. A locative after klausīties is not automatically a grammar error.

lt-numerals.title: Lithuanian Fire and Rescue Department: Graphic signs and numeral writing
lt-numerals.evidence: The style note allows bare Arabic numeral notation for numbered days (example 17 diena); attached ordinal endings are optional and depend on the numeral. The proposed wording avoids a fixed suffix that could fail for day 3.
lt-numerals.type: primary official language/style guidance, not legal-policy advice
